verdict.rationale: Dialpad's API reference documents company-level webhook resources (a list-webhooks endpoint), and its docs reference event subscriptions, so registrable outbound callbacks exist as a first-party capability. The pack does not show that call and message events specifically are delivered to those webhooks; the only event-subscription item cited is websocket-based. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of call and SMS/message event types delivered via webhooks, webhook creation and payload/signing details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, call and message events arrive as webhooks I can wire into my own systems

citations.quote: Gets a list of all the webhooks that are associated with the company.
